overview: This Senate resolution names August 3 through 9, 2025, as "National Farmers Market Week." It notes the growth in the number of farmers markets across the country and their role in providing income to farmers, connecting city and rural communities, and helping low-income families who receive federal nutrition benefits get fresh food. The resolution recognizes the part farmers markets play in local economies and community life. It does not change any law or spending. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on July 30, 2025.
for: Supporters say farmers markets help small farms earn a living, give families access to fresh local food, and strengthen local economies, and deserve recognition.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic: it doesn't change any law or provide new support for farmers or markets.
